Boolean gate for mint(); toggled by startMint() and pauseMint()

Metadata base URI returned by _baseURI(); writable through setBaseURI()
IERC20 payment token contract used by mint() and withdraw()
payable mint(uint tokensToMint): validates input, pulls SOS via transferFrom, then mints tokens in a loop
onlyOwner withdraw(): transfers the whole SOS balance of the contract to the owner
internal view override returning the baseURI state variable
onlyOwner setter that overwrites baseURI
onlyOwner function setting mintStarted to true
onlyOwner function setting mintStarted to false

External ERC20 transfer in withdraw() sending the contract balance to the owner
Internal ERC721 mint invoked in a loop for every requested token, mutating ownership state

Local variable: cost = tokensToMint.mul(mintPrice) computed in mint()
Local variable: sosToken.allowance(msg.sender, address(this)) read in mint()
uint16 loop counter of the mint() for-loop

edges.reason: msg.sender is supplied as the from argument of the external sosToken.transferFrom call
mint() executes the external sosToken.transferFrom call
the sosToken state variable is the target contract of the external transferFrom call
tokensMinted is written only after the external token transfer returns, so a reentrant call operates on stale mint state
a malicious ERC20 can re-enter mint() during transferFrom before tokensMinted is incremented
the computed cost is passed as the amount of the sosToken.transferFrom call
cost is derived from the user-controlled tokensToMint multiplied by mintPrice
mintPrice is the constant multiplier used in the cost computation
the allowance is read from the sosToken contract instance
msg.sender and address(this) are the keys of the allowance lookup
the queried allowance is validated by a require inside mint()
require(mintStarted) gates the execution of mint()
batchLimit bounds the caller-supplied tokensToMint in mint()
maxTokens bounds tokensMinted + tokensToMint in mint()
tokensMinted is read by the supply check and by the mint loop
msg.sender is the payer for the SOS transfer and the receiver of the minted tokens
tokensToMint determines how many times _mint is executed
msg.sender is passed as the to-address of each _mint call
the loop counter i controls how many times _mint is called
the derived token id is passed as the tokenId argument of _mint
id is computed as tokensMinted + 1 inside the mint loop
tokensMinted is incremented after every successful _mint
withdraw() executes the external sosToken.transfer call
the sosToken state variable is the contract called by withdraw()
setBaseURI writes the newBaseURI parameter into the baseURI state variable
_baseURI returns the current baseURI state variable
the constructor casts sosTokenAddress and assigns it to sosToken
startMint sets mintStarted to true
pauseMint sets mintStarted to false
onlyOwner requires msg.sender to equal owner() before withdraw() executes
onlyOwner restricts setBaseURI to the contract owner
onlyOwner restricts startMint to the contract owner
onlyOwner restricts pauseMint to the contract owner

normalization_plan.reason: tokensToMint is only the caller-supplied argument of mint() and has no independent meaning outside that function
the cost local variable exists solely to feed the amount of the external sosToken.transferFrom call
the allowance local variable is only used to guard the SOS pull performed by sosToken.transferFrom
the loop counter i has no effect outside the token minting loop of mint()
the id local variable is computed purely to be passed as the tokenId of the _mint call
newBaseURI is only the write value of setBaseURI and carries no standalone semantics
sosTokenAddress is consumed only by the constructor to initialize the sosToken state variable
